/trading/get-trades.x-server-method-enforcement: not enforced; POST is the native constructor method

post.description: Native trade-data projection. Android consumes competed_trades; completed_trades is retained as an equal legacy alias. Same pending rejection history reproduced and verified the notification fix. Both actors' post-accept owned inventories match the guarded swap; final native/legacy completed arrays equal with one record. Nested record schemas and broader transfer variants remain partial; intermediate capture gaps are disclosed.

player_id.description: Native constructor includes it; replacement authenticates session_id and derives caller identity instead.

200.description: Existing trade projection with equal native/legacy completed arrays

competed_trades.description: Native Android 2.41.0 completed-list key; equals completed_trades for empty and populated results.

schema.description: Replacement projection; nested record schemas remain partial. Both completed-list keys project the same existing array without changing records, ordering, visibility or economics.

x-native-decision-proof.observations: Native false/true decisions, exact guarded two-spare ownership swap, one completion, no parent/offers, both actors refreshed inventories matching post-accept DB, active parties/resources preserved and boolean locks false. Final GetTrades native/legacy completed arrays equal with one record.
x-native-decision-proof.capture_limits: Twelve PCAPs and 33 selected exchanges; intermediate observations and a missing-offer capture gap remain disclosed. No continuous uninterrupted cycle claimed.

post.description: Protected creation at current owned/active-deck state. Existing economic policy retained; later party transitions are guarded separately in trade-party-transitions.md. Authentication is in JSON, not the cancellation cookie.

Reviewed Android three-field request and body-agnostic success. Replacement authorization/transaction policy documented in trade-response-implementation.md; native requester Reject/Accept, exact guarded spare swap and both actors' inventory refreshes are verified. Selected captures disclose intermediate gaps; broader transfer variants remain separate. When cookie and Bearer are both supplied they must agree. Acceptance rechecks both outgoing instances against current active parties; withdrawal remains available for unsafe legacy listings.
